title: Descriptor docs freeze pass
lead: The documentation half of the schema v1 freeze, split from sq-12 (owner, 2026-10-30): make `docs/descriptor.md` normative, add its changelog, document the frozen limits, mark unproduced members as planned for a 1.x minor, make the README examples real output, and do the final how-it-works pass. **Not in this slice:** the schema file, the validator, the walker, the invariants, any golden or any descriptor byte.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: sq-12 as specified was a from-scratch build of the schema plus a docs pass; the owner chose to split it. Owner decisions already recorded on sq-12 apply here verbatim: S12-1, S12-3, S12-4, S12-6, S12-8 (read them with `slicer show sq-12`), and on 2026-10-30: nullable members "Allowed only behind an explicit top-level marker (Recommended)" and sketch values "Yes, state it in the policy (Recommended)".

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `docs/descriptor.md`: the "draft" label dropped; the versioning policy normative, including "adding an enum value is a minor change" (replace the line that says it is pending sq-12), the cut rule and window sniff of sq-40 (a change that moves `scope.bytesRead` is a change of meaning), the sq-47 precedent rule (a member may become null only behind a documented top-level marker such as `layoutOnly: true`; otherwise nulling an always-present member is a major change), and the sketch rule (sketched quantile values are approximate and may be refined in a minor release; keys, types and the `rankError` contract stay); a changelog (starting point and format chosen by the implementer and listed); the documented limits (single-letter units in the underscore form: Site_A as amps, Temp_F as farad; the degC alias, DEGC is a unit and DEG is not, `unitTable` 1 stays; the shape-mask `?` for a literal `?` or a classless character; the cut-mask `+`: exactly 65 tokens ending in a bare `+`); members documented but produced by nothing yet (`stdf`, `hints.stdf`, the touchstone and keyValue dialects, `sections`, `binary.blocks`, `binary.segments`, `limits.stdfTests`, `kind` labels beyond the interim ones) marked planned for a 1.x minor and not v1.0.
- `README.md` usage examples become real output (run them); `docs/design.md`, `docs/user-guide.md` where they say "draft", "unreleased" about the schema or point at the policy.
- `docs/how-it-works.md`: banner status and final text pass; re-render html and pdf.
- Tests in the existing docs-test style (`tests/squalify.Cli.Tests/DocsTests.cs` or the descriptor-doc tests): the three below.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `Docs_StateTheFreezeRules`: descriptor.md states the policy as normative, "adding an enum value is a minor change", the cut rule and window sniff, the layoutOnly marker rule, the sketch-values rule, the unit-table limitation, the shape-mask `?` and the cut-mask `+` rules, and marks the unproduced members as planned.
2. `Readme_Examples_AreRealOutput`: the README usage example output matches a real run on the fixture it names.
3. `Docs_PlannedMembers_AreNotInTheSchemaOrTheWriter`: every member descriptor.md marks as planned is produced by no code path (no golden contains it); once sq-12's schema exists, none appears in `schema/descriptor-v1.schema.json` either.
- Mutation-check each test.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the three tests and watch them fail. 2. Docs: descriptor.md, README (run the examples), design.md, user-guide.md. 3. how-it-works.md final pass and re-render (`PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" ./scripts/render-docs.sh`); commit .md, .html and .pdf together (the owner commits). 4. Start from main after sq-12 lands.

Owner decisions (2026-10-30, from the sq-49 architect finding A1), verbatim: Other records "State it in the guide: constructors/Deconstruct are outside the promise (Recommended)" (option text: "'Guarantees and stability' says model-record constructors and Deconstruct are not covered by the compatibility promise; reading members is stable; ProfileOptions.Create and FieldProfile by name are the stable construction paths. Written in sq-54's docs pass, no extra slice."). So this slice adds to docs/user-guide.md 'Guarantees and stability' (and the descriptor.md policy where it fits) that constructors and Deconstruct of the model records are outside the compatibility promise, members stay readable, and the stable construction paths are ProfileOptions/ProfileOptions.Create and FieldProfile built by name with init members (sq-49). Add a failing docs test for it to Docs_StateTheFreezeRules.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; docs tests pass; the architect confirms no drift in docs/how-it-works.md; `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: The owner commits. Do not commit; never add Co-Authored-By or similar lines.
